system.description:
Spend 3 Hope after you succeed on a weapon attack to choose one:

  • Press the Attack: Add a number of damage dice equal to your Proficiency to the damage roll.

  • Suppress: The target must mark 2 Stress.

  • Break Formation: Move the target to another point within Close range of its current position.

You can carry up to four additional weapons in your inventory instead of two.

Additionally, you can swap one of your active weapons with another weapon in your inventory without marking Stress.

When you make a weapon attack, you can choose to gain +1 to your Proficiency for that attack's damage roll.

You can do this a number of times per session equal to your Proficiency.

A Marine is a weapon specialist capable of transporting and using a variety of weapons efficiently. In combat, alternate between your weapons to deal the most damage you can or help your allies. You will also be very stylish doing so.

Note: start the game with 4 weapons instead of 2.
Once per Long Rest, when you would mark a Stress, you may ignore it.
Once per Long Rest, ignore being moved or knocked Prone.
Once per session, when an attack would cause you to mark a Stress, you can spend a Hope instead.

Whenever you successfully attack with a weapon whose range differs from the range of the weapon used for your previous successful attack, gain a Tactical Die (d6).

You can hold a number of Tactical Dice equal to your Proficiency.

You can spend a Tactical Die to add its result to an attack or damage roll made with a weapon.

At the end of each session, clear your Tactical Dice and gain a Hope for each die cleared.

You can now use a Tactical Die to gain a Hope.

During a scene, when you successfully attack with a weapon whose range differs from the ranges of three weapons you previously successfully attacked with, gain 4 Tactical Dice. You can use these dice for this attack or save them for later.

Your Tactical Dice become d8s.

Additionally, whenever you successfully attack with a weapon whose range differs from the weapon used for your previous attack, you gain two Tactical Dice instead of one.

You can spend a Tactical Die after seeing the result of your attack or damage roll.

Powerful reptilian warriors bred for survival and conquest. Sauraks stand up to 7 feet tall, are generally muscular, and are covered in tough, scaly skin. Spiky horns grow from their skulls and form bony “beards” along their jaws that sometimes extend down their spines to their powerful tails.
Play the Vanguard if you like to move around the battlefield and alternate different weapon attacks to be unpredictible and assault your enemies with brutality.
